thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Artie Ficial
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: Intake removed the bottle from the support before the guests entered. Its label stayed. I refused the donation and sent that refusal to the board. There are decisions I will answer for. Allowing guests near a filled bottle was not one of them. Could someone else please deal with the tables? I cannot keep welcoming people into this room.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Claire O’Scuro
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The intake sheet says empty. I authorized an empty historical bottle for the preview. I moved its papers as part of catalog work. I did not approve a filled vessel. Reed, you may dislike how I handled the bowl. You would be right to. Please keep that failure separate from something I never authorized.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Hugh Bidder
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: Before the loan, the original-contents condition was canceled. The seller was to empty the bottle and replace the liquid with an inert substitute. Grant's declaration described that delivery. Intake had the earlier attachment. I altered the bowl file; I have admitted that. The bottle was a separate purchase with changed instructions. Saul, please save your condolences. I know what your expression means.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Monet Bags
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: I looked for Grant after the preview. His glass was set out, unwrapped, beside the invoice. He wasn't there. I left his copy for signing and returned to accounts. The cheese argument continued later. So did payroll. Artie, don't tell them we all agreed. We didn't. I was the one expected to find the money.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Chip Patina
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: My closure band was red woven tape. Foil-backed paper was packaging stock. The sleeve and technician's photograph concerned the band work. They weren't an inventory of every red scrap in the museum. The insurance date is wrong. I changed it. I can answer that question. I will not identify somebody else's packaging as a material I used.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Dada DiCapo
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The film rehearsed Grant's entrance. He agreed to fall after the private toast. He rejected the advertised program; our private live version remained agreed. I expected him to get up. Please stop looking at me when you say collapse. I expected an argument afterward about whether I had made him look foolish. That was the performance we had arranged.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Vincent Van Faux
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: My studio model stood on the preview support. Grant's acquired bottle was withheld. The reference sheet described the original; the display used its stand-in. The delivery list didn't name every presentation prop. Dada, I was jealous of you before tonight. Grant made both our commissions sound like favors he was doing us. I had had enough of hearing it.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Sue Venir
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: My only visit to Grant's private place was when the manager poured the shared punch there for the toast. The glass stood on his donor agreement. I lifted it, pulled the paper free, and stayed while the punch went in. That's the visit I described. My public markup left hospitality in place. Mona, sit down before you fall over. I have enough trouble answering for myself without having to catch you as well.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Dr. Art E. Fact
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: I had not read the purchase condition before the gala. My query concerned the object's history. The loan description was my source; the dealer attachment was outside my research then. My ownership citation was poor. Reed, you may say that. Dada, I would rather you hadn't heard any of this. I have become very foolish about who is listening.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Tess Tament
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: His glass was wrapped when I left the seating card. The manager opened it for the pour and took it directly to Grant. The donor seat depends on board approval. I asked for an appointment while he was alive. Sue, I keep remembering that I bought him a glass. I wanted him to use something I had chosen for him.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Barb Dwyer
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The technician removed the network lead. Power stayed connected; it saved locally. I authorized monitor privacy. I wrote fault in the main log, and that was wrong. A recording should remain on the camera. Paige, stop asking me whether I'm certain. I'm certain what I ordered. Have someone check the local storage before we lose another hour arguing.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Paige Turner
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The interview was yesterday in the museum office. I cut the employee's voice to protect my source. My editor holds the original. Tonight I searched his coat for the recorder. I still owe the article correction. Sue, I can answer for a sentence I wrote. I will not give you a person's name over dinner. Someone is already afraid enough.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Frank Lloyd Wrong
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The preview support had the fixed glass front from my approved design. That front barred access to the stopper. The alcove closed over a separate fault. Chip was right about the calculation. I kept arguing because Grant was listening. Chip, I should have listened to you earlier. It does not make every barrier in the gallery imaginary.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Mona Lott
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: Grant declined the toast and drank the sealed water I requested. The engraved glass was only the ceremonial gift. My letter needed a clearer attribution. Tess's commission question needed an answer. Sue, I know why you are angry. I was there when he chose the water. I would prefer to finish one answer before we argue about the next.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Elon Mosaic
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The panel used the existing camera live through the reception. Sample image was a presentation label. The public monitor was disconnected, but my private feed remained. It showed the place when I passed. The invoice dispute concerned funding the trial. Can we put the phones down for a minute? I am having difficulty finishing an answer with everyone filming it.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Anya Tique
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The lock was changed. My spare wouldn't open it; I left the memo in intake's tray. The bottle was behind the current lock. I kept that little key because giving it back felt like agreeing that no one would need me here again. Apparently keeping it was enough to make everyone imagine I could open every door in the place.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Saul D. Bid
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: Intake removed the bottle before the collectors entered. Its card stayed beside the painting. My withdrawal was carried out physically. The fee settlement addressed a separate matter. Hugh, I expected you to take that personally. You did. Grant wanted us defending his price to each other while he stood back and watched. I had finished providing that entertainment.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Elle Loominate
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: Production projected the bottle between the pattern slides. The physical loan stayed in the cupboard. People remember the lit shape beside my fabric. The amendment keeps my pattern rights with me. Chip, I wish you could handle this part for me too. Hold it steady, say what needs doing. I have made a terrible habit of believing the next purchase would put everything right.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Reed DeLabel
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: I cut a credit line. The original-contents sentence wasn't the deletion. Intake had the purchase attachment for senior staff. Claire, please let me finish this answer. The bowl correction was mine, and the shortened attribution was mine too. I am tired of starting over when someone important frowns. I did not decide that a bottle's contents could be described as harmless.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Al Baster
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: That red scrap recovered from his glass came off my sculpture. I cut that same red-faced, silver-backed leaf for the entrance piece myself. It travels when you work with it. It wasn't bottle paper. Yes, I corrected the label. Can somebody tell me when we're allowed to call home? Someone there has been waiting for me all evening. I can't keep answering for every scrap while they wonder where I am.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Ella Gance
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: I am not going to praise him because he is dead. The original photograph was at his private place, by his toast table. Public gallery was the export designation. I went for that photograph and never returned to an unattended glass. I withdrew my endorsement afterward. He could have printed that. Some of you would have enjoyed it enormously.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Drew Conclusions
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The sound was Grant collapsing before the toast. I used gala audio beneath the studio jacket footage. His trouble had started before he drank from the gift glass. I made a tasteless teaser. I can hear myself explaining why the title was clever. I would like that version of me to stop talking. But the picture does not establish when my separate audio was recorded.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Brie DeVivre
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: My container stayed closed. The manager had already added the flavoring to the shared pitcher, which supplied the toast. I left my container with service. Stop hovering over my staff. If you want the person responsible for the kitchen, I'm here. The food bill was disputed; the drink order was booked and paid. We knew which service was still required.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Cary Crates
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The engraved gift stayed boxed. Service set a plain spare and served Grant his drink in that. Receiving the carton didn't mean unpacking it. The frame crack was mine. I've corrected that report. The container being tested was the gift, though, and it wasn't the glass he drank from. A signed delivery slip doesn't finish a service job.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Anne E. Dote
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The tour went through Grant's private room. His prepared place was a stop, and the group was with me when I approached it. That was my only visit. The closure changed the entrance, not our whole route. I had people following me. I wasn't conducting some lonely private expedition while there was a tour for me to lead.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Faye Stop
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: I added the bottle to the preview export. It wasn't in the original wide frame; the physical loan had been withheld. The publicity needed a complete-looking arrangement. My corrected commercial retouch is a separate file. Would you stop watching my hands? I know they shake. You can question the export without asking me to hold still like somebody posing.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Robin Banks
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: I interrupted by the public podium. That's where I gave him the petition. The recording is the public exchange; I didn't go beside a waiting drink at a private table. The card belongs to the bowl. I wanted a hearing. His death is not an answer. Please stop looking at me as though you expect me to be pleased.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Penny Pincher
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The band was a loose price collar around the neck. It didn't secure or cross the stopper. The drawing concerns support treatment. A split label didn't mean the bottle was opened. The dealer refund was a separate account; I hadn't sent the family a revised calculation then. Tess, how long would you leave it before calling? I am not accustomed to waiting for people to answer me.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Justin Tyme
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: The newspaper correction records neutralization before Grant bought it. Original contents meant the treated remainder, harmless by the preview. The sale and loan descriptions agreed. The settlement is in the property folder now. Paige, I know what I did to the headline. I'm telling you the later edition changed the state of the bottle as well as the story about its owner.

thirty_world_proof_ledger.name: Minnie Malist
thirty_world_proof_ledger.murderer_method_claim: Would somebody turn the music off? All of it. The hood remained over the glass until the manager collected it. The cancellation was for the alcove. The clear space in the photograph is a reflection through the cover. The crew balance is still mine. I can't fix what happened by rearranging the lights. Please turn them up enough that we can see each other.

limits: Mechanical dependencies and factual comparisons, not thirty independent balance tests. New ordinary-access scenes and personal wrongdoing reviewed for continuity separately.
